requirement: Node.js on a supported LTS release, declared via engines.node, .nvmrc or .node-version
No TypeScript and no .ts/.tsx sources; package.json type=module; .js/.mjs sources
No second backend language (.py/.go/.java/.rs/.rb/.php/.cs) in product code
Express declared as a dependency and used for HTTP routes
Rules, scheduling, validation and import/export live in separate modules, not inside route handlers
A CLI entry (bin or npm script) runs the scheduler with no API or website
React and Vite declared; vite config present; no TSX sources

item: Frontend consumes the shared API contract
requirement: Website calls /api/*; no duplicated scheduling or validation rules in the frontend

item: Same routes and shapes with deterministic fixtures
requirement: BeggarDev mock exposes the same Express routes and response shapes, backed by JSON fixtures
One documented, versioned schema module; JSON is the interchange format
Imported data and API payloads are validated at the boundary (zod/ajv/joi/valibot)
Export writers for CSV, XLSX and PDF exist or are declared
JSON-first storage behind a small repository interface so SQLite can be added without touching the scheduler or API
Dependencies declared per manifest with a lockfile; no undeclared or global deps
A documented local run needs neither the website nor a remote service
README stack section stays current and every change is recorded in log.md
